task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A low-angle, wide-angle fisheye view captures a skateboarder in a bright green t-shirt, dark pants, and a dark cap performing tricks inside an indoor skatepark. The camera follows the skater from behind as they ride across a smooth, light-colored floor, approaching a curved wooden ramp or ledge decorated with vibrant, colorful graffiti featuring large bubble letters in pink, yellow, blue, and green. The skater executes a trick, possibly a grind or slide, along the edge of the ramp, then rides away and back across the open floor space. The background reveals more of the skatepark, including other ramps, a high ceiling with exposed beams and circular lights, and additional graffiti-covered walls. The skater's movements are fluid, and the camera pans to keep them centered, highlighting the dynamic action and the colorful, urban aesthetic of the environment.
